decision.outcome: Refuted: every production record starts at or before its own transcript lines. The window's lower bound equals the record's baselineCutoffMs (hook.ts createSessionRecord writes baselineCutoffMs: startTime; run-window.ts:22), so a line before it is baselined by the base's own cutoff and never becomes a delta; a generation created over a foreign record starts at the previous generation's last activity, not at Date.now(); Desktop records start at baselineCutoffMs ?? createdAt; for the other agents the hook creates the record at its SessionStart, before any line of that native session, and a resumed native session's earlier lines belong to the earlier record by the window rule. Kimi's event.time is epoch milliseconds (13-digit fixtures; parseDeltaTime takes a number as ms).
decision.rationale: The moved fixtures described records no path creates; a live capture of a Stop-created generation shows its deltas 20-29 s after startTime.

decision.outcome: Kept as is, named in the PR description (Impact: 'Not changed by this PR'): a kimi step or an opencode message with no time of its own keeps the processing time as its delta time and the run window judges it at that time; only a wrapper or daemon pass over a transcript shared with a later record can drop such a delta from the earlier record, and the delta time never reaches the backend.
decision.rationale: Exempting synthesized times from the window would let a late pass credit a later record's lines to an earlier one; the documented behaviour is the safer side.

Fixed: a SessionEnd whose final write pass fails on a session-file lock timeout does not complete the record — no completed, no end metric, no rename; it stays active and the next CodeMie start finalizes it as stranded with the tail re-processed first (hook.ts performIncrementalSync returns lockTimedOut, finalizeSession / handleSessionEnd return keptActive). Test: a held metrics lock past the budget → active, no end-metric request, the set live; the stranded pass then writes the missed line (hook.session-delivery.test.ts).
decision.rationale: The lock timeout is recognised from the writer's message because the adapters hand the hook only { success, message }; no other error text matches today.

decision.outcome: Fixed in part, the rest kept as is: the lock timeout after an accepted upload is caught and reported as not persisted; the deltas stay pending and are re-sent by a later pass.
